name: Pega Blueprint
description: Pega Blueprint is an AI-powered application design tool that accelerates delivery from early discovery to production go-live, keeping governance and best practices front and center. This connector exposes Blueprint's generation engine to Claude via MCP, letting users turn a plain-language idea into a complete, build-ready application design without leaving the conversation. A user describes what they want, and Claude calls the Blueprint tool to produce a full design in one step: case lifecycle stages, the steps within each stage, supporting data objects, channels, and personas. The result can be reviewed conversationally and carried into the Pega Platform for build. Because generation happens through a single tool call, Claude can iterate in dialogue — refining stages, expanding data models, or reframing the workflow — and regenerate as the conversation evolves. Designs follow established architectural patterns rather than ad-hoc structure, with security and governance built into the foundation and data kept under the customer's control. Teams use Blueprint to move from initial concept to a working application far faster than traditional design approaches allow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pega Blueprint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pega Blueprint to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pega.com/prweb/app/dcoai/api/service/v1/mcp/default.

_published_faq.name: Is Pega Blueprint MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Pega Blueprint scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pega Blueprint MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pega Blueprint provides these MCP tools: Create_Blueprint.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pega Blueprint?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pega Blueprint in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Pega Blueprint MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pega Blueprint does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Pega Blueprint failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pega Blueprint scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
